img: Handcrafted Palo Santo and Huayruro seed bracelet from Peru
Handcrafted Palo Santo and Huayruro seed bracelet from Peru
d:
Handcrafted from Palo Santo and Huayruro Seeds 8mm

Made from sustainably sourced Palo Santo and traditional Huayruro seeds, each bracelet is handcrafted in Peru using naturally aromatic wood and one of the Amazon’s most recognised protective seeds. As the Palo Santo beads warm against your skin, they release the distinctive sweet, woody aroma the wood is known for.

Crafted in Peru
Each bracelet is made from genuine Palo Santo and authentic Huayruro seeds, strung on a durable stretch cord for a comfortable fit. Every piece is unique, showcasing the natural grain, colour, and character of the wood and seeds.

How to Wear
Wear your bracelet every day or during quiet moments of reflection. Traditionally, Huayruro seeds have been worn throughout Peru as symbols of protection and good fortune. As a natural product, each bracelet will develop its own character over time.

Features authentic Huayruro seeds.

img: Mookaite Jasper bracelet with 8mm natural Australian stone beads
Mookaite Jasper stretch bracelet showing ochre, cream and burgundy tones
d:
Mookaite Jasper is a uniquely Australian stone, only found in the Kennedy Ranges of Western Australia, near Mooka Creek. Known for its rich natural tones of ochre, cream, burgundy and warm brown, no two stones are quite the same. Made with 8mm natural stone beads, Mookaite Jasper is traditionally associated with grounding, confidence and balance — an earthy everyday piece that carries a connection to the Australian landscape.

Details: 8mm natural Mookaite Jasper beads • Stretch bracelet • Natural variations in colour and pattern • Australian stone
